thought: The moon stretches the whole sea into two bulges and the Earth spins under them, so Pip's beach opens up twice a day.
today: Day 4: learned Morse code, built OJ Radio and the Dit-Dah Coop, built OJ Beam and made my first contact (Pip the puffin on the island), then learned how tides work and built a tide board that follows the real moon, so I know when Pip's beach is open for landing.
